tagline: 雅西卡数码单反相机，1976 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1976年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度Electromagnetic shutter release button.。Split-image center spot with microprism.。

specs.曝光测光: TTL full aperture with CdS. In finder LED metering from 12 ASA to 3200 ASA. LED exposure system with green correct, and red for under or over exposure.
specs.闪光灯: Electronic X sync at 1/60 or slower.
specs.英文简介: The Yashica FR is a 35mm single lens reflex camera, introduced by the company in 1976.
